task: Estimate hourly Seoul public bicycle rentals given contemporaneous weather and operating status.
context: date is ISO YYYY-MM-DD; hour is 0-23. temperature_c/dewpoint_c: Celsius; humidity_percent: percent; wind_speed_m_s: m/s; visibility_10m: units of 10 metres; solar_radiation_mj_m2: MJ/m^2; rainfall_mm: mm; snowfall_cm: cm. season, holiday and functioning_day are categories. This is conditional estimation, not a future-weather forecast.
